description: The exact DrMaker3D instant-quote price for printing a person's 3D model file, from the same engine and the same measurements as the instant quote page. Pass the file the person attached (as file), or upload it first: POST https://drmaker3d.com/api/upload as multipart/form-data with fields file (STL, OBJ, 3MF, GLB, glTF or PLY, up to 25 MB) and kind=printiq, and pass the "key" it returns as file_key. The file is kept privately by the studio for the quote. Returns the price, size, turnaround and a checkout_item to pass to create_checkout. Painted multicolor files, STEP files, parts too big for one piece and model links (Printables, Thingiverse, MakerWorld) are quoted by hand: it says so, and request_quote sends them to Rich.

color.description: A color of that material from print_options, e.g. "Black" or "Matte Charcoal".

copies.description: How many of the model, default 1.

email.description: The person's own email, supplied with permission. Required when the instant-price email gate is enabled; never invent an address.

file.description: The person's model file as ChatGPT passes an attached file (a link on files.oaiusercontent.com or OpenAI’s own file storage). Give this or file_key.

file_key.description: The key POST /api/upload returned (starts with "printiq/"). Give this or file.

finish.description: Optional color family, e.g. "PLA Matte", when a color name is in two families.

infill.description: Percent, default 20. 50 and up for functional parts.

material.description: A material from print_options, e.g. PLA, PETG, "TPU (flexible)", ABS, ASA, "Nylon (PA)", PC, PA-CF, PETG-CF.

quality.description: Default standard. Draft only for parts 100 mm or more across.

units.description: Default mm. "inches" for an STL or OBJ drawn in inches.

name: quote_custom_print
title: Instant price for a 3D model file
